name: Foleon
description_en:
Foleon is a hosted platform for creating responsive HTML5 documents such as reports, brochures, proposals and content hubs. Teams build pages from templates or blocks, apply shared brand assets and route content for review before publication. It is designed around interactive document experiences rather than general application data management.

Its commercial scope includes role-based authoring, workspaces, analytics, AI allowances and optional extensions. Self-hosted document output is available under eligible plans, but exported documents lose personalization, editions, platform access control and search. Export therefore changes the product behavior and needs its own acceptance test.
description_zh:
Foleon是托管内容平台，用于创建响应式HTML5报告、宣传册、提案及内容中心等文档。团队通过模板或区块建页、应用共享品牌资产，并在发布前送审；它围绕互动文档体验设计，而非通用应用数据管理。

商业范围包含分角色创作、工作区、分析、AI额度及可选扩展。符合条件的套餐可自托管文档输出，但导出后不保留个性化、editions、平台访问控制及搜索，因此导出会改变产品行为，需单独验收。

core_features.explanation_en: Start a document/page from a template or blank canvas, then compose blocks and approved assets.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档/页面可从模板或空白开始，再组合区块及获准资产。

core_features.explanation_en: Brand kits, templates, workspaces and global modules govern reuse, with quantities and permissions varying by plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 品牌套件、模板、工作区及全局模块支持复用治理，数量及权限随套餐而异。

core_features.explanation_en: Eligible accounts can configure publication approval/checklists and hosted reader access; exported documents do not retain those reader controls.
core_features.explanation_zh: 符合条件账户可配置发布审批/清单及托管读者访问，导出文档不保留这些读者控制。

pricing.summary_en: Quote-ledSpark/Team/Enterprise with role/workspace/credit/module/chart allowances and optional extensions;no numeric subscription or overage/renewal quote established.
pricing.summary_zh: Spark/Team/Enterprise需报价，按角色/工作区/积分/模块/图表额度及可选扩展划分；未建立数字订阅价或超额/续费报价。

sources.title: Choose a plan that's right for you – Foleon

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Build a branded report from pages and reusable assets
sections.title_zh: 通过页面及复用资产构建品牌报告
sections.en:
For an illustrative annual report, select an approved document template, name the first page and add the required sections. The page guide distinguishes starting an entire Doc from a template, which can prefill pages, from selecting a template for an individual page. A blank page accepts drag-and-drop blocks; additional pages are added through Pages > New page. Templates can come from the workspace, Brand Console or Foleon library.

Use real headings, media, charts and accessibility checks in the pilot, then inspect mobile presentation before review. The product describes Content Builder for non-designers and Content Studio for custom design. Its semantic HTML/JSON-LD/AEO claims do not guarantee search rankings, AI citations or an accessible result for every author’s document.
sections.zh:
例如年报，可选获准文档模板、命名首个页面并补齐章节。建页指南区分整份Doc从模板开始（可预填多页）与为单独页面选模板；空白页可拖放区块，后续页面通过Pages > New page增加，模板可来自工作区、Brand Console或Foleon库。

试点应使用真实标题、媒体、图表及可访问性检查，送审前检查移动展示。产品将Content Builder面向非设计者，Content Studio用于定制设计；其语义HTML/JSON-LD/AEO描述不保证搜索排名、AI引用或每位作者的文档都可访问。

sections.title_en: Check publication rights and notification behavior
sections.title_zh: 检查发布权限及通知行为
sections.en:
The detailed approval guide has administrators enable publishing approval in Admin Console > Content Governance > Approval Flow. Authors without publishing rights can submit a Doc to reviewers who have publishing rights and access to the same workspace. A permitted reviewer then approves and publishes. A separate pre-publishing checklist can require tasks to be checked before publication or republication.

Notifications are not real time: users must refresh, and notifications older than7days are not displayed. This display window should not be confused with a verified audit-retention period. For acceptance, submit from a non-publisher, refresh the reviewer view, check the email/notification and confirm who can make the Doc public. Generic marketing descriptions of multi-step approvals should be reconciled with the actual plan and configured flow.
sections.zh:
详细审批指南要求管理员在Admin Console > Content Governance > Approval Flow启用发布审批；无发布权作者可提交给有发布权且可访问同一工作区的审阅者，后者批准并发布。另有发布前清单，可要求发布或重新发布前勾选任务。

通知并非实时，用户需刷新，超过7天的通知不显示；这个展示窗口不能当作已核实审计保留期。验收可用非发布者提交、刷新审阅视图、检查邮件/通知，再确认谁能公开Doc。营销页的多级审批描述需与实际套餐和配置流程核对。

sections.title_en: Compare creator roles, workspaces and release status
sections.title_zh: 比较创作者角色、工作区及功能发布状态
sections.en:
Plans are quote-led. Spark lists2Premium+3Standard users,7,500AI credits/month, up to20reviewers,2custom domains and2Brand Kits. Team lists5Premium+10Standard users,15,000credits,2workspaces expandable to4,unlimited reviewers/custom domains,50Global Content Modules and25DataViz charts. Enterprise lists10Premium+20Standard users,55,000credits,3workspaces with expansion,unlimited modules,100charts and up to100Brand Kits. Confirm what each user role can actually do and the cost of additions.

The page labels the new Grid editor, MCP access and offline mode as Coming Soon; Answer Agents are Beta. Do not count those as generally available production capabilities. Video, DataViz and agent extensions may have separate scope; unlimited Docs is not unlimited seats, credits, charts or every extension. No numeric subscription price, credit-overage rate or renewal quote was established.
sections.zh:
套餐需报价。Spark列2Premium+3Standard用户、每月7,500AI积分、最多20审阅者、2自定义域名及2品牌套件；Team列5Premium+10Standard用户、15,000积分、2工作区可扩到4、不限审阅者/域名、50全局模块及25DataViz图表；Enterprise列10Premium+20Standard用户、55,000积分、3工作区可扩、不限模块、100图表及最多100品牌套件。需确认各用户角色实际权限及增加成本。

页面将新Grid编辑器、MCP访问和离线模式标为Coming Soon，Answer Agents为Beta，不能当作普遍可用生产功能。视频、DataViz及agent扩展可能另有范围；不限Doc不等于席位、积分、图表或全部扩展无限。本次未建立订阅数字价、积分超额价或续费报价。

sections.title_en: Distinguish reader authentication from lead capture
sections.title_zh: 区分读者认证及留资门槛
sections.en:
Hosted Doc access methods depend on the plan and include shared username/password, public-IP allowlists, email one-time links and SSO, with an SSO-plus-email-allowlist option. Email links are valid for1hour and one use; after use, the same browser/device can retain access through a cookie for5days. Email entries must be lowercase, and changes to allowlists require republishing. The guide allows up to400individual email addresses and recommends SSO for larger groups.

A mail-security scanner can consume a one-time link before the recipient opens it. Test that failure path, the cookie session and direct page access. Lead-generation forms are another content gate, not automatically the same authentication mechanism. Account/platform SSO and reader Doc SSO also have distinct scope.
sections.zh:
托管Doc访问方式按套餐提供，包括共享用户名/密码、公共IP白名单、邮件一次性链接、SSO及SSO加邮件白名单。邮件链接有效1小时、仅用一次，使用后同浏览器/设备可通过cookie保持5天访问；邮件必须小写，白名单修改需重新发布。指南最多支持400个单独邮箱，更大群体建议SSO。

邮件安全扫描器可能先消费一次性链接，需测试该失败路径、cookie会话及直达页访问。留资表单是另一种内容门槛，并不自动等同认证；账户/平台SSO与读者Doc SSO也有不同范围。

sections.title_en: Export static output with its lost capabilities understood
sections.title_zh: 理解能力损失后再导出静态内容
sections.en:
The self-host guide says an eligible account can request compression from the Doc thumbnail menu and receive a download link by email. It gives a380MBmaximum for generating the archive. Although the action is named Compress to ZIP, the instructions describe extracting a compressed tarball; inspect the actual delivered archive instead of assuming its format. The output contains static HTML, JavaScript, CSS and images and needs anHTTP(S)web server rather than opening local files.

Personalization, editions and Foleon access control do not work after self-hosting, and search is disabled. The guide expects gated forms to continue and says custom remarketing/GTM scripts are included, so review those dependencies and tracking/consent behavior separately. Exporting output is not a license to self-host the authoring application, and it is not a complete platform backup. A protected hosted document must not be assumed protected after export.
sections.zh:
自托管指南称符合条件账户可在Doc缩略图菜单请求压缩，通过邮件收下载链接，并列生成归档上限380MB。操作名为Compress to ZIP，但说明描述解压tarball，应检查实际文件格式。输出含静态HTML、JavaScript、CSS和图片，需HTTP(S)网页服务器，不能直接本地打开。

自托管后个性化、editions及Foleon访问控制不工作，搜索也被关闭。指南预期留资表单仍工作，且自定义remarketing/GTM脚本会包含，因此需另查依赖、跟踪及同意行为。输出导出不授权自托管创作应用，也不是完整平台备份；不能假定原托管受限文档导出后仍受保护。

sections.title_en: Test the delivery mode the audience will actually use
sections.title_zh: 测试受众实际使用的交付方式
sections.en:
Foleon fits teams producing branded, interactive documents across departments with controlled templates and review. Shared assets/modules can reduce repeated editing, but propagated changes still need ownership and publication checks. It is a different choice from a general application CMS or a portable source-document editor.

Pilot a realistic report from template to review, a global module update, authenticated reading and the intended hosting/export mode. Confirm cancellation, content retrieval, AI-data handling, credit renewal and which dynamic services survive export. No editor session, approval, SSO/OTP flow,380MBboundary,export,analytics measurement orAIagent was executed; public security/compliance assertions were not independently audited.
sections.zh:
Foleon适合跨部门生产品牌互动文档、希望控制模板及审阅的团队。共享资产/模块可减少重复编辑，但传播改动仍需责任方及发布检查；它与通用应用CMS或可移交源文档编辑器是不同选择。

试点应让真实报告从模板走到审阅，测试全局模块更新、认证阅读及目标托管/导出模式；确认取消、内容取回、AI数据处理、积分刷新及哪些动态服务在导出后保留。本次未执行编辑、审批、SSO/OTP、380MB边界、导出、分析测量或AI agent，未独立审计公开安全/合规主张。

research_gaps.zh: 数字费用、角色权益、积分超额/刷新、取消/取回、AI条款及路线图/Beta功能实际可用性需确认。
未执行创作/审批/OTP/SSO、共享模块传播、导出/重新托管、表单/跟踪或agent测试。
